details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. One named workflow or script. Reply with its path, e.g. `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` or `scripts/<name>.sh` (RECOMMENDED)
B. One pipeline phase (clarify / plan / implement / review-autofix / orchestrate / validate). Name the phase.
C. Documentation only (README.md, docs/, agents.d fragments)
D. Something else. Describe it in your answer.
Q2: What does "better" mean for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Give a failing run URL, an error message, or the steps to reproduce it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make it faster or use fewer resources (runtime, API calls, runner slots, tokens).
C. Improve reliability or recovery (fewer stalls, retries, or manual interventions).
D. Improve clarity: docs, log messages, or prompts.
E. Add a specific new feature. Describe it.
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete, checkable condition you give, e.g. "run X no longer fails with Y" or "job count drops from N to M" (RECOMMENDED)
B. New or updated contract tests pass that cover the behaviour you describe in Q2.
C. You will review the PR and judge it yourself. Note: without A or B, the plan stays small and changes only what Q1/Q2 name.
